我的生活与自然(My Life and nature): 一篇关于自然环境的A2短文:大卫与格蕾丝的经历和小计划。
David and Grace had great fun there. David wants to be a teacher in the future. Both of them like noodles and milk. Best of all, the turkey stuffing is made with onions and sage.
David usually has noodles for breakfast. David learned a lot about history. It takes twenty minutes to get to the green hill by bike. Each entree comes with soup or salad.
Life is full of small surprises. David wrote about the day in the diary. David hopes to visit Paris one day. Also, missing the bus will only complicate our morning plans.
They took many photos at the city park. There are always many people at the city park. David plays chess with Grace every Saturday.
